thread:
maria: Quick FYI — planned weekend deploy v2.8.1 set for Saturday 03:00 UTC. This includes the model-routing tweak and batcher tuning. Need oncall coverage + rollout watchers. Plan below.

aj: I can cover 02:45-05:00 UTC. Primary for rollback and runbook ops.

sachin: I'll watch app metrics 03:00-03:45 (errors/latency). Noted a small p95 uptick in staging earlier, will escalate if p99 crosses thresholds.

iona: Infra freeze reminder — ops locked infra changes between 02:50-03:20 UTC. Please avoid merging infra PRs from 01:50-03:40 UTC to be safe.

maria: Rollout plan: canary 3% for 10m -> 20% for 20m -> 100% if green. Watchers: sachin (metrics), iona (capacity), aj (rollback). Rollback triggers: p99 > 800ms sustained 5m OR error-rate > 1% sustained 3m. Also monitor unexpected region spillover.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated — v2.8.1 @ 03:00 UTC (3% traffic) :rocket: 

sachin: Seeing some kv cache misses at canary start, small latency spike on long-context requests. Snippet:
```
[03:01:12] kv_cache: miss key=conv-42 seq=1024
[03:01:12] latency: 420ms -> 670ms (long ctx)
```
p99 currently ~730ms, watching.

aj: Thanks. If p99 > 800ms for 5m I'll execute rollback steps in runbook (/runbooks/rollbacks/v2.8.1). Also monitoring retry churn and client-side backoffs.

maria: Note for Dedicated customers: routing policy should avoid spilling into shared west pools. @iona please confirm capacity alerts are configured.

iona: Confirmed — added alert for pool_utilization > 70% for 2m. Will page infra if triggered. Also added a safelist to prevent model-routing from spilling to shared us-west pools.

sachin: Quick ping @sean re: batching tweak correctness. The change touches tokenization path; could be edge-cases with mixed encodings.

sean: I'll take a look at PR #4271 today. If I see anything concerning I'll branch a hotfix. Otherwise small patch, no infra changes expected.

maria: Handoff: I'm partially available via DM. Coverage: @aj 02:45-05:00 UTC. Watchers: sachin (03:00-03:45), iona (capacity/infra), sean (CR follow-up). Post short status lines in this thread. :thumbsup:

aj: Will post status at +5m and +20m after canary start, and immediately if rollback criteria met.

sachin: Observed p99 hit 810ms at 03:05 but it dropped after 90s — not sustained. Error-rate still <0.2%. Continuing to monitor.

aj: Acknowledged, keeping a close eye. If we see sustained degradation I'll trigger rollback and notify infra/product.

maria: Thanks team. If anyone sees routing spillover to other regions or shared pools, call it out immediately here and in #eng-oncall.

sean: CR review complete — minor nits, approved. No blockers for ramp.

sachin: +status 03:20 — canary at 20%, metrics stable, no error spikes.

aj: +status 03:35 — 20% holding, no rollback. I'll stay on until 05:00 UTC.

maria: Closing handoff note — final ramp to 100% at 03:50 UTC if no regressions. Thanks all for coverage.
